items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: I don't need no music to play no second behind Alba Fernandez or one of them. He don't need no music to play no second behind me on his alto.

ctx.x: I don't need no music to play no second behind Alba Fernandez or one of them. He don't need no music to play no second behind me on his alto. He's training his guys already. He's been doing it so long.
That looks like that's about it. It's about two seconds.
